title: MNLU Nagpur Registrar meets protesting students, assures time bound action
description: The Registrar of Maharashtra National Law University (MNLU), Nagpur on Monday met with students protesting over a range of grievances, including the suppression of dissent.The University has agreed to a series of time bound commitments arising from the meeting, though certain issues remain under negotiation.A document created during the meeting records proposed measures across four timelines.
